{{nihongo|'''Izanami Shrine'''|伊射奈美神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

=== History ===
It is one of the candidate shrines for Izanami Shrine in Mima District, Awa Province, listed in the Shikinaisha. Formerly a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. In old times it was called Jūnisha Daigongen / Jūnisho Daigongen. Its founding is unknown, but there is a record that a provincial offering was made in Enryaku 7<ref>''{{ill|Kadokawa Nihon Chimei Daijiten|Q4093011|qid=Q4093011}} 36 Tokushima Prefecture'' (1986 ISBN 4040013603), entry "Izanami Shrine (Anabuki-chō)"</ref>. ''Meishin Jojū'' gives a founding around the {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} period ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}-{{ill|877|ab|877|af|877|als|877|am|877 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|877|ar|877|ary|877|ast|877|avk|877|az|877|azb|۸۷۷ (میلادی)|bcl|877|be|877|be_x_old|877|bg|877|bn|৮৭৭|bpy|মারি ৮৭৭|br|877|bs|877.|ca|877|cdo|877 nièng|ceb|877|ckb|٨٧٧|crh|877|cs|877|csb|877|cv|877|cy|877|da|877|de|877|el|877|eml|877|eo|877|es|877|et|877|eu|877|fa|۸۷۷ (میلادی)|fi|877|fo|877|fr|877|frr|877|fy|877|ga|877|gan|877年|gd|877|gl|877|he|877|hi|877|hr|877.|ht|877 (almanak jilyen)|hu|877|hy|877|id|877|ilo|877|io|877|is|877|it|877|ja|877年|jv|877|ka|877|kaa|877|kk|877 жыл|ko|877년|la|877|lb|877|lij|877|lmo|877|lt|877 m.|lv|877. gads|map_bms|877|mdf|877|mg|877|mhr|877|mk|877|mr|इ.स. ८७७|mrj|877 и|ms|877|mzn|۸۷۷|nah|877|nap|877|nds|877|new|सन् ८७७|nl|877|nn|877|no|877|nrm|877|nso|877|oc|877|or|୮୭୭|os|877-æм аз|pa|877|pl|877|pnb|877|pt|877|qu|877|ro|877|ru|877 год|rue|877|sa|८७७|scn|877|sd|877ع|se|877|sh|877.|shn|877|si|877|sk|877|sl|877|smn|877|sq|877|sr|877|su|877|sv|877|sw|877|tg|Соли 877|th|พ.ศ. 1420|tk|877|tl|877|tly|877|tr|877|tt|877 ел|uk|877|ur|877ء|uz|877|vec|877|vi|877|vls|877|war|877|wuu|877年|xmf|877|zh|877年|zh_min_nan|877 nî|zh_yue|877年|qid=Q23905}}).

The same-named {{ill|Izanami Shrine, Mima|ja|伊射奈美神社 (美馬町)|qid=Q43594855|lt=Izanami Shrine}} in {{ill|Mimachō|Q11609479|qid=Q11609479}} of the same city and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kōtsu Shrine}} are also listed as candidate shrines for the same Shikinaisha.
